mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS YoY growth falls below -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals supply-side contraction, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO is below its 12-month MA for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for two consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy coinciding with disinflation, which increases discount rates and reduces growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising AND CPIAUCSL < 2% for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL < 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
